annotations.text:
DIRECTION A — "Late Night"
The whole loop in one direction: your shows with live progress, a show page, the episode checklist, and browsing to add something new.
The check buttons on My Shows and the checkboxes in the episode list really work — tap them and the bars move.

TWO OTHER LOOKS — same My Shows screen, different aesthetic
B "Logbook": paper and ink, and one tick per episode instead of a bar — you see the actual episodes left, not a percentage.
C "Signal": dark terminal, segmented bars, and a pace label (on pace / 2 behind).
Tell me which direction feels right and I'll build the rest of the screens in it.
